Name: The Queen Of Sauce Reminder
Author: TheShwamp
Description:
[size=5]The Queen Of Sauce Reminder
[/size]Will simply just remind you to watch TV to learn a new cooking recipes

I have added i18n support without speaking any of the languages. If you have any suggestions to the translations, please submitt them on [url=https://github.com/Swampen/stardew-valley-mods/issues/new]GitHub[/url].

[size=4]Config[/size]
By default, the reminder will be enabled on Wednesdays and Sundays.
You can disable the day you do not want a reminder on in the config.

[size=3]Experimental future
[/size]You can enable the reminder for only unknown recipes, this is disabled by default.
